story: Gesar was born miraculously, through a divine or magical conception, sometimes said to descend from a father who was both sky god and holy mountain, and a mother who was a goddess of the watery underworld. As a child he was ugly, black, snotty, and troublesome, and was despised. He had two uncles: one, an old and wise elder, supported him, while the other, cowardly and greedy, saw the boy as a threat and tried to harm him. This second uncle banished Gesar and his mother to a remote plateau, where the boy grew up living a feral life, clothed in animal skins and wearing a hat of antelope horns. When Gesar reached the age of twelve, a horse race was held: whoever won would marry the beautiful daughter of a neighboring chieftain and become king of the kingdom of Ling. Gesar won the race on his miraculous steed, married the chieftain's daughter, and ascended the throne, taking the title "Great Lion, Wish-fulfilling Jewel, Subduer of Foes." With thirty companions he then waged war against enemy lands. While he was away fighting a man-eating demon, his wife was kidnapped by a rival king. Gesar returned, used magic to infiltrate the enemy's palace, killed the king, and recovered his wife. He then fought two more kings of foreign lands, and set out to conquer eighteen great fortresses, battling various foreign adversaries. In some versions, at age thirty-nine he retreated to a sacred hill. In old age, in his eighties, he descended briefly into Hell before finally leaving the world of men and ascending to a celestial paradise, from which he may return in the future to save his people from their enemies.
